text_block_list.text:
Following the Osaka Hai, Maruzensky 
devotes herself to training more intensely 
than ever before.

Meanwhile, they felt uneasy seeing how 
overly strained Grass Wonder and Special 
Week appeared.

And those anxieties proved true when Grass 
Wonder suffered an injury.

Unable to just watch, Maruzensky explained 
the importance of enjoying training to the 
girls, who kept recklessly overworking 
themselves out of sheer impatience.

Thanks to her advice, the two of them 
successfully got back in top shape.
